entities.description: A close-up view of two individuals sitting on a bench, with one person wearing gray leggings and holding an apple, and the other person with bare legs and a black top. The bench has a dark surface and is positioned on a light wooden floor.

The floor is a light-colored wooden surface with a smooth finish and visible grain patterns, appearing clean and well-maintained. It serves as the base for the scene, providing a neutral background that contrasts with the darker elements above it.

A close-up view of a bright orange metal locker featuring a small, rectangular silver lock mechanism on the upper left and horizontal ventilation slits near the bottom. The surface appears smooth and painted, with a person's blonde hair partially obscuring the left edge of the frame.

A close-up view of a matte orange metal locker door featuring a series of horizontal ventilation slits near the bottom. A vertical blue strip runs along the right edge of the frame, contrasting with the orange surface.
A close-up of a person's arm and side, wearing a teal short-sleeved shirt, with the background showing an orange locker with horizontal ventilation slits and a small white label or sticker.

background.locker: orange, with horizontal ventilation slits and a small white label or sticker

entities.description: A close-up profile view of an elderly woman with short, light blonde hair, positioned in the foreground against a blurred background of a bright orange locker. The locker features a smooth surface with a small, rectangular silver handle or lock mechanism visible on the left and a set of horizontal ventilation slits on the right.

A close-up of a person's upper body, showing their bare shoulder and arm, with a white towel draped over their shoulder. The person is wearing a gray shirt, and the background features an orange locker.

A close-up of a person's upper body, showing the right shoulder and arm, wearing a teal short-sleeved t-shirt. The background is an orange locker with horizontal ridges and a small white label or sticker near the top.

A close-up view of the top of a person's head with messy, light blonde hair positioned in front of a bright orange locker door. The locker features a vertical blue frame on the left side and a small, rectangular silver handle or lock mechanism visible on the left edge.
A close-up of a person's hand and forearm, with a white towel draped over the shoulder, in front of an orange locker with horizontal ventilation slits and a small rectangular label or handle.

A close-up view of a solid orange locker door featuring a small, vertical silver handle on the left side and a set of four horizontal ventilation slits near the bottom. The surface appears smooth and matte, framed by a dark blue vertical edge on the left.

A close-up view of the top portion of a person's head with light brown or blonde hair, positioned in front of a bright orange locker door. The locker has a smooth, matte finish and is framed by a blue vertical edge on the left side, with a small, rectangular metallic label or handle visible on the lower left corner of the orange surface.

A fair-skinned woman with shoulder-length blonde hair sits on a bench in a locker room, wearing a grey tank top and black shorts with a white towel draped around her neck. She holds a black smartphone in her hands and gestures with her right hand while looking to the side with an engaged expression, wearing white wired earbuds.

An older woman with short, wavy blonde hair sits in profile facing right, wearing a teal t-shirt and grey leggings while holding a red apple in her hands. She has a neutral expression and is positioned in front of a row of orange lockers with blue frames.
